title: 鐵路車站排煙整合
summary: 本課聚焦車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合。從排煙斷面速度分布建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風速量級與壓力與控制與照明備援連成可驗證的介面，最後以排煙模式整合案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements. Start with velocity distribution in exhaust sections to define physical or information boundaries, connect air-speed scale and pressure with backup for controls and lighting as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through integrated smoke-mode cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究排煙斷面速度分布。原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。敏感度只改 A=16 至 17.6 m2，輸出變為 1.81818 m/s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究風機壓升能量帳：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. For sensitivity, change only A=16 to 17.6 m2; the output becomes 1.81818 m/s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate fan pressure and energy accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「排煙斷面速度分布」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排煙斷面速度分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean. Direction and smoke-source location also matter. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。以「排煙斷面速度分布」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 本單元以孔口近似比較門開度與壓差，明示此模型無法解析上下反向的分層煙流。開口通風量由壓差驅動，受面積與縮流損失共同控制。流量和壓差平方根成正比，不是線性比例；旁通開口增加可能減輕壓力卻同時改變煙氣路徑，因此開口位置和通風模式必須一起討論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門口與旁通流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「煙流與清空時間邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
